dedupe_keys.name: charged multi city ev charging demand dataset

description: The Intelligent Systems Lab publishes CHARGED, harmonized electric-vehicle charging demand across several cities. The current Zenodo concept release lists city-specific five-minute archives, an hourly package and a README. The describing article says city folders contain complete and filtered versions that remove charging sites with zero duration and volume. Public data are free under CC BY 4.0. These profiles can calibrate spatial and temporal charging-demand models or test station-capacity scenarios, with data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging providing a separate benchmark. A caveat is that provider coverage and local reporting rules vary by city; a harmonized table does not ensure identical sampling frames. The filtered variant also changes the meaning of zero demand. Exact city time zones and station identifiers require checking in the files. The archive metadata and repository documentation were read; no charging transactions were downloaded.
